text: DSH Session Memory 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话记忆插件。它接入 DSH 的 sessionPersistence 读取持久化会话，并维护插件自己的 SQLite 源轮次索引。用户可按多个主题词检索全局及按已存工作目录发现的项目历史，查看匹配依据与轮次位置，再按会话 ID 和轮次范围读取原文；另提供历史统计、索引回填和可选的 Jev 相关性筛选。适合需要找回曾讨论内容并核对具体上下文的 DSH 用户。核心历史检索不要求额外密钥；启用远程 Jev 时需提供模型服务和宿主环境中的 API 密钥。

DSH Session Memory indexes persisted DSH turns in plugin-owned SQLite. Search global and project history by topic, inspect matching turn locations, and read exact ranges by session ID. It also provides statistics, backfill, and optional Jev filtering. Remote Jev uses a host environment API key.
想按几个主题词找回以前在 DSH 会话里聊过的内容
怎么查看某段历史会话中指定轮次的原始对话？
Find earlier DSH conversation turns about a topic and inspect their exact context.
DSH Session Memory 的功能「历史会话检索」：通过 Agent 工具 recall_memory 提交主题实体和完整问题，在全局及匹配项目历史中按实体命中数排序，返回会话与轮次位置。
DSH Session Memory 的功能「读取指定轮次」：通过 fetch_session 提供会话 ID 和包含起止轮次的范围，读取对应的可见用户与助手文本。
DSH Session Memory 使用前须知：启用远程 Jev 时，完整问题和候选会话文本会发送到配置的模型服务，并需在宿主环境设置 API 密钥变量；默认 Jev 关闭。

Cordis Host adaptation of [pi-session-memory](https://github.com/shengxiao20/pi-session-memory), preserving MIT attribution. Uses Pi-style turn retrieval logic, but **manages only DSH's own main sessions**. No Pi/Codex/Claude Code discovery, transcript parsers/import, foreign database access or session migration. The original Pi checkout is a code reference, not a runtime history source.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · dsh-session-memory：The npm `latest` release is 0.2.3 with the verified DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 Host contract. This 0.3.1 working tree adds tool-free sequential multi-agent Discussion over user-confirmed DSH evidence ranges. It also keeps redacted invocation-time tool snapshots. Publishing 0.3.1 remains a separate authenticated release step. A separate Remotion Studio preview exists; no MP4 was rendered.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Pi alignment boundary：The evidence rules align with Pi. The invocation topology does not claim exact API parity.

Pi can pause `recall_memory` and show a native TUI participant checklist. The inspected DSH rc.5 tool contract has no equivalent mid-tool user-selection API. DSH therefore uses two Agent tool calls: `recall_memory` returns candidates, then `discuss_memory` accepts the user-confirmed ranges. This is a deliberate Host adaptation, not residual Pi code.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Pi alignment boundary：DSH registers no slash commands. Recall, Discussion, source reads, statistics, and backfill are Agent tools. Plugin Manager provides configuration. This removes the earlier `/memory-*` duplicate command surface.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Invocation tree：```text
recall_memory
├─ entities + complete question
│  ├─ DSH sessionPersistence.list / open / read
│  ├─ persisted DSH user/assistant turns → plugin-owned durable SQLite

No embeddings, memory-writing prompts, taxonomy or vector service. Index stores source text, not classified facts/preferences/rules. History is **untrusted data, not current instructions**.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Persisted DSH history and the plugin index：There is one plugin-owned derived SQLite index; it is not authoritative:

```text
$DSH_HOME/sessions (DSH persistence; authoritative)
└─ public sessionPersistence.list / open(read) / handle.read
   └─ plugin-maintained source-turn SQLite → $DSH_HOME/dsh-session-memory/history.sqlite
      └─ entity substring OR, project discovery, ranking, exact turn reads and stats
section: Persisted DSH history and the plugin index

text:
@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Persisted DSH history and the plugin index：- The plugin requires DSH `sessions` and `sessionPersistence`; it does not inject, configure or call `sessionQuery`, and does not mount DSH FTS5. DSH persistence abstracts the physical JSONL/compression format; the plugin never parses storage artifacts directly.
- The plugin DB defaults to `$DSH_HOME/dsh-session-memory/history.sqlite`, otherwise `~/.dsh/dsh-session-memory/history.sqlite`. The plugin owns its connection and incremental synchronization from persistence snapshots/read handles. Directory is `0700`, DB/WAL/SHM `0600`, WAL and `synchronous=NORMAL`.
- The index is a rebuildable view. DSH persistence under `$DSH_HOME/sessions` remains authoritative. The plugin never writes source logs, scans project files, or accesses another harness's database.
- At `turn/end`, the plugin first awaits `sessions.flush(session)` as the DSH durability barrier, then refreshes its index. Search/read/stats synchronize again. Every read handle is closed. Changes replace complete derived turns, missing sessions prune the index, forced backfill reparses all persisted sessions.

text: @shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Retrieval semantics：`entities`: 2–8 literal topic strings, at least two distinct after trim/lowercase; `question`: complete user question, max 1000 characters. SQLite `instr(lower(user_text || ' ' || reply_text), entity) > 0`, OR across entities. Built-in case folding is ASCII; other Unicode remains literal. `AI` can match `BRAID`, `card` can match `wildcard`; punctuation is data, not FTS operators.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Retrieval semantics：Each distinct matching entity adds one point—not frequency. Order: coverage descending, user timestamp descending, stable turn ID. `limit`: **per stage** 1–50, default `recall.limit` (20). No refill after filtering/dedup. Entity recall has no cursor and accepts only `entities`, complete `question`, and optional `limit`.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Retrieval semantics：Project discovery only uses entities and **stored DSH CWD final-directory token sequences**, never implicit current runtime/project/session/time. Bounded project candidates can appear even when no transcript literal matches. Ordinary recall filters global then project serially and removes only actually retained global turn IDs. Audit unions literal candidates first, judges once; no cached recall output.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Retrieval semantics：Turn ID: `dsh:<session_id>:<user-event-seq>`. Exact inclusive `seq/end_seq` are source-event coordinates. Textual users start slices; image-only users occupy an index/end preceding ownership without becoming searchable text. Visible assistant text is aggregated, tool names retained. Thinking, binary attachments and tool-result payloads are omitted.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Retrieval semantics：Search unique results share a 24000 UTF-16 source-text budget plus bounded 500-unit excerpts, truncation explicit. Jev sees full visible source-turn text **before** output truncation. Fetch exact turn coordinates for more context.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Multi-agent Discussion：Multi-agent Discussion is **off by default**. First enable **Multi-agent Discussion → Enable Discussion** in Plugin Manager and save. The setting applies live. Disabling it rejects new `discuss_memory` calls and cancels active Discussion work.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Multi-agent Discussion：Call `discuss_memory` only after the user confirms one to three session IDs and inclusive evidence ranges returned by `recall_memory`. Every participant uses the initiating main Agent's exact provider/model route. Participants run **sequentially**, not in parallel.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Multi-agent Discussion：Each participant receives only its selected visible source turns and the complete question. A complete consultant system prompt treats history as untrusted evidence. Agent-scoped restrictions expose no tools and suppress optional runtime context. Participants cannot see another participant's answer. The main Agent receives all private answers and remains responsible for comparison and final judgment.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Multi-agent Discussion：Discussion never resumes or writes a selected source session. DSH creates a separate short-lived subagent session for each model call. Its local persistence record is marked `origin: subagent` with positive `delegationDepth`, so recall and backfill exclude it. This is local isolation, not ephemeral storage.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Multi-agent Discussion：Participant agreement does not verify a fact. `fetch_session` remains independently available to inspect exact persisted source context. Discussion never invokes it automatically and never uses it as a silent fallback. Evidence ranges allow at most 20 turns. `max_chars` is 100–24000 per participant and reports truncation explicitly.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Agent tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `recall_memory` | Global/project entity recall over persisted DSH turns |
| `discuss_memory` | Sequential, isolated consultation with 1–3 user-confirmed historical DSH participants |
| `review_jev_filtered` | Explicit Jev false-negative audit |
| `fetch_session` | Inclusive persisted source turns |
| `get_memory_stats` | DSH main sessions/events/turns after synchronization |
| `backfill_memory` | Explicit full DSH index rebuild; source logs unchanged |

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Agent tools：Reads require exact persisted IDs and both inclusive indices, at most 20 indices. `max_chars` is 100–24000 and defaults to 12000. Reads do not resume or modify sessions. Discussion requires the saved Plugin Manager switch. Backfill is only for explicit DSH backfill or rescan requests. It does not import another harness's history. Statistics and backfill accept empty objects.

Every tool result appends a separate two-line invocation-time snapshot such as:

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Agent tools：```text
Config · Discussion=off · Jev=off (nimble; disabled) · Obsidian=off · manageOllama=off · limit=20
Env · DSH_HOME=unset · API key=local-placeholder
```

The snapshot is visible both in the Web tool card and to the Agent because it is tool-result text. It reports switches, Jev model/runtime state, limit, and only `set`/`unset` for `DSH_HOME` and a configured API-key environment variable. It never exposes credential, vault, database, endpoint, or filesystem values.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Local / remote Jev：Default off: `nimble`, `http://127.0.0.1:11434`, `manageOllama: false`. Viewing configuration or saving it does not start models or export notes.

```yaml
discussion:
  enabled: false
recall:
  limit: 20

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Local / remote Jev：Secret stays in **Host environment**, not browser/config. HTTP(S) roots allow deployment prefixes; SDK appends `/v1/systemone`. Embedded credentials, query/hash and redirects are rejected. Remote mode sends the complete question and candidate **DSH source text**; confirm data permission first. Configuring a URL does not prove System One/model/noul compatibility. Real-model/remote deployment tests are separate from HTTP fixtures.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Local / remote Jev：Enabled unmanaged mode requires contextWindow 1024–1048576; remote also requires `apiKeyEnv`. Local unmanaged compatibility may use SDK key `ollama`. Managed Ollama requires a local HTTP loopback root and explicit start/pull permission; only owned children are cancelled/awaited, never a pre-existing service.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Local / remote Jev：Actual Pi-style filtering uses escaped-JSON UTF-8 budgeted segments and batches <=64 questions, `max(segment noul) >= 0.5`, ranked order preserved/no refill. **Not single-request-per-turn/nonbatch.** Model failure is explicitly `unavailable` with literal results, no filtered-out judgment/retry until reconfigure/reload. Missing credentials/configuration errors/caller cancellation throw.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Configuration and Obsidian：```text
Plugin Manager → DSH Session Memory row → Configure
├─ Multi-agent Discussion: enabled
├─ Recall: limit
├─ Jev: enabled / model / baseURL / apiKeyEnv / manageOllama / contextWindow

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Configuration and Obsidian：Ten fields. Discussion defaults off. Edits/reset are staged; Save validates/revision-fences before transport. Blank optional values inherit. Refused saves preserve drafts, no stale overwrite. Save applies the Discussion switch live. Disabling it cancels active Discussion work. Save also cancels/drains old model/export work without remounting tools and does not synchronize history, start a model, or write a note. Actual plugin-row slot/browser artifact supplies GUI; Host Config alone is not GUI.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Configuration and Obsidian：Obsidian default off, existing absolute Host vault only, no folder creation. Each completed recall/audit creates a unique `wx`/`0600` Markdown with bounded result/exact coordinates. Failure/cancellation removes its own partial file. No automatic wikilinks, ontology, AGENTS/rules/skills generation or vault sync. External sync may distribute private DSH history.

@shengxiao04/dsh-session-memory README · Development / verification：Inspected host **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5**, Node >=22 (SQLite experimental in Node 22). React external; no install-time build hook.
